title: National PE-18 Electronic Flash Unit with Cord & Case - Used
descriptionText: The National Electronic Flash Unit Model PE-18 is a high-quality shoe mount flash unit designed for use with cameras. Made in Japan, this unit comes with a cord and a protective case, ensuring that it is both reliable and well-protected. The National brand is known for producing top-notch flash accessories, and the PE-18 model is no exception, offering photographers a dependable and durable option for enhancing their photography setups.
